# Volume 4 timeline

## CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Wright](../character/diana-wright.md), [Small Anne Cordelia](../character/small-anne-cordelia.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) chat in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret while [Diana](../character/diana.md) holds her small child. [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses finishing her teaching duties, her upcoming marriage to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their plans to move to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hears Anne's laughter from the kitchen below, reflecting warmly on Anne's future.

## CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) excitedly prepare wedding gifts and discuss Anne's upcoming marriage. Later, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), and Mrs. Jasper Bell visit to view Anne's trousseau and offer mixed comments. Finally, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives and joins [Anne](../character/anne.md) for a walk, describing the seaside house in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) he has found for their new home.

## CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her upcoming wedding plans and guest list with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). Friends and family arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the ceremony, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), as well as [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and her husband. On the evening before her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits Matthew's grave and walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), reflecting happily on their shared past and upcoming future.

## CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), Allans, [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Small Anne Cordelia](../character/small-anne-cordelia.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) awakens on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her past in her little room. Friends and family gather as preparations finish and [Anne](../character/anne.md) marries [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the sunshine of the old orchard. After a joyous celebration, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary as their loved ones bid them farewell.

## CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drive together through the picturesque scenery toward their new home at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). Along the way, [Anne](../character/anne.md) admires the landscape and notices a remarkably beautiful girl driving geese near a starkly neat house. They finally arrive at their new house, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md) across the threshold.

## CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are welcomed to their new home at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) by [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), his wife, and Captain Jim. They enjoy a lively supper together while learning about their surrounding neighbors and the local community.

## CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Ned Russell](../character/ned-russell.md), [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Captain Jim entertains [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) by telling the romantic story of the house's first bride and her schoolmaster husband. Afterwards, he bids his hosts farewell and shares with [Anne](../character/anne.md) their common bond as 'kindred spirits.'

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Elizabeth](../character/elizabeth.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — Captain Jim and [Anne](../character/anne.md) bond over their shared nature as "kindred spirits," or people who belong to the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md). As the guests prepare to leave in the moonlight, Captain Jim shares stories and praises the beauty of [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). After everyone departs, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk through their garden, grateful for their happy home.

## CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on their happy honeymoon month at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and Gilbert's successful emergency medical case. Later, Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) arrives to call on [Anne](../character/anne.md), bringing her sewing and offering her sharp, frank opinions on men, local neighbors, and church denomination differences while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) listens in from the office.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — Miss Cornelia shares her opinionated views on men, local ministers, and former residents, including [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md) and Captain Jim. [Anne](../character/anne.md) asks for a recommendation for garden work, and Miss Cornelia accepts Anne's invitation to stay for tea, noting that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been listening and laughing from the next room.

## CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Elizabeth](../character/elizabeth.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) Light in the evening, encountering the strangely bearded [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) along the way. At the lighthouse, Captain Jim warmly welcomes them, showing them his model schooner, the mechanism of the light, and his orange cat, the [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). Over tea and a driftwood fire, Captain Jim explains [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) Elliott's political vow and shares stories of his past and saved animals.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), A Mad Love, [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)** — Captain Jim explains how he rescued the [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md) and shares why he preferred dogs to cats. He then shows [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) his collection of curios and enthalls them with vivid, true tales from his adventurous life at sea. After reminiscing and inviting them back, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk home reflecting on Captain Jim's character and past.

## CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes for a evening walk on the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and encounters [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), her mysterious neighbor. They share a conversation about their surroundings, beauty, and pasts before agreeing to exchange visits. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her encounter and impressions of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and shares news before relaying the long, painful backstory of [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). She details Leslie's tragic childhood, forced marriage to [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), and the accident that left [Dick](../character/dick.md) an imbecile whom [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must now care for. [Anne](../character/anne.md) listens with deep sympathy as Miss Cornelia explains Leslie's enduring hardship.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), Methodist, Presbyterian** — Miss Cornelia asks about Anne's encounter with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) on the shore and encourages [Anne](../character/anne.md) to persist in being Leslie's friend despite her cold demeanor. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to do all she can to reach out to the lonely, tragic [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and Miss Cornelia reassures [Anne](../character/anne.md) of Leslie's true [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) faith.

## CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Glen, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at their home, where she enjoys fudge, conversation, and the offer to borrow books. Despite relaxing and showing her warm, joyful side during the visit, she becomes distant again when leaving as she reflects on what she lacks. After [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) departs, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a tender moment discussing beauty and Anne's hair color.

## CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks through a foggy evening to visit [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), but turns back after seeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping intensely in private. Outside, she meets Captain Jim leading [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) home; Captain Jim then walks [Anne](../character/anne.md) back to her house while they discuss [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Dick's tragic situation.

## CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend autumn evenings visiting Captain Jim at the lighthouse, often accompanied by [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). On their walk home, they discuss Leslie's wasted potential before turning to affectionate teaseing about Anne's past suitor and their shared joy in their own home.

## CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) visiting from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia join as dinner guests, engaging in lively debate and storytelling over the holiday meal.

## CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) walk to the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse to ring in the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) with Captain Jim, his nephew Joe, [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), and the [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). After music, dancing, and storytelling around the fire, Captain Jim opens the door at midnight to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year).

## CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Diana Wright](../character/diana-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — During a cold winter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend time together, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) senses a lingering distance and occasional resentment from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). Captain Jim explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Leslie's past tragedy creates a barrier between them. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) hints at her pregnancy, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reacts coldly but later gifts her a handmade baby dress. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shares his journal of sea adventures with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who hope someone will one day write his life story.

## CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — As spring arrives at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) to decorate her garden beds with shells and bring her sweet-grass and mayflowers. Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim engage in lively, humorous debates about religion, books, and local neighbors alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). When [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) returns with news about a sick neighbor, her unconscious funny remark causes Captain Jim and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to step outside to laugh.

## CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives to stay with [Anne](../character/anne.md), and soon after, [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes into labor and gives birth to a baby girl named Joyce. Tragically, the baby dies shortly after birth, devastating [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their friends. [Anne](../character/anne.md) endures a long, difficult recovery filled with deep grief, struggling to reconcile her loss while receiving support from her loved ones.

## CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne.md) to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to sit outdoors, leaving her with Captain Jim while he sees a patient. Sitting among the rocks, Captain Jim comforts [Anne](../character/anne.md) regarding her lost baby Joyce and shares the tragic story of his long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). He asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to remember [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) and pass her story on to future generations so she won't be forgotten.

## CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Kenneth](../character/kenneth.md), [God](../character/god.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confesses her past envy and conflicting feelings toward [Anne](../character/anne.md) while they sit in the garden. She explains how her painful history led to these bitter emotions, but sharing them helps clear the air between them. [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers comfort and understanding, cementing a deeper, lasting friendship between the two women.

## CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Rhoda Allonby](../character/rhoda-allonby.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) insist that [Anne](../character/anne.md) keep [Susan](../character/susan.md) on as hired help for the summer to regain her health. Captain Jim and [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) visit [Anne](../character/anne.md), exchanging humorous banter about fruit-stealing boys and local robins. Miss Cornelia reports that [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) has agreed to take in a summer boarder, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), who is a writer and the grandson of the house's original owner.

## CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) brings writer [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) to Anne's home so [Anne](../character/anne.md) can guide him to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) Moore's house, where he will be boarding. During their walk, Owen expresses his connection to the area through his grandfather [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) and confides his hope to write a great Canadian novel. Upon arriving, Owen is struck by Leslie's striking beauty and is warmly introduced into her household.

## CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home and discusses [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), after which Owen visits and enjoys a moonlit sail with them. Two nights later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) takes Owen to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to introduce him to Captain Jim, who recounts old memories and thrilling sea tales. Impressed by Captain Jim's experiences, Owen is enthralled by his life-book and borrows it to read at home.

## CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), Blythes, [Dick](../character/dick.md), Four Winds Harbor, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) agrees to write Captain Jim's life story combined with the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he sets up a workspace at the lighthouse. Over a memorable summer, Owen works intensely on the manuscript while spending joyful leisure time with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and Captain Jim. As September arrives, Owen finishes the main draft of his book and announces that his stay at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) is coming to an end.

## CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he is deeply in love with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and expresses his agony over having to leave her in her miserable marriage. [Anne](../character/anne.md) sympathizes with his grief, and they share a quiet moment watching the twilight until Miss Cornelia arrives and breaks the tragic mood with her usual sensible manner.

## CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) accompanies [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the harbor to the sand shore, where she meets [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) wandering alone in distress. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) tearfully confesses her unrequited love for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), while [Anne](../character/anne.md) comforts her and keeps Owen's own feelings secret. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) collects them in his boat, and later at home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discourages [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) from speculating on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Owen's hypothetical match.

## CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Fiske](../character/fiske.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Leavitt](../character/leavitt.md), [Henry](../character/henry.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) to read obituaries and gossip about local history and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enters, the conversation shifts to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) mourning her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend the holidays in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and return to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), where Captain Jim shares news that his life-book will be published.

## CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Rhoda Allonby](../character/rhoda-allonby.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Dave](../character/uncle-dave.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discusses with [Anne](../character/anne.md) his belief that an operation on [Dick](../character/dick.md) Moore's skull could restore his memory and sanity. [Anne](../character/anne.md) strongly opposes telling [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), arguing that it would inflict further misery and financial strain on her. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) maintains that it is his medical and moral duty to tell [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) the truth and give her the choice, despite Doctor Dave's advice to leave well enough alone.

## CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) visit Captain Jim to discuss whether [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) should be told about the operation that might cure [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md). Despite Anne's reservations, Captain Jim agrees with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must be informed. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) ultimately decides to proceed with taking [Dick](../character/dick.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation, while Miss Cornelia later vents her fierce disapproval to [Anne](../character/anne.md).

## CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) prepares her house and borrows money from Captain Jim before travelling to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for Dick's operation. After returning home, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) wait anxiously for news, until [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives a shocking letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that the man was actually Dick's cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that the real [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) died years ago.

## CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), Four Sisters, [George](../character/george.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), Nova Scotia, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) arrives at Anne's home in shock after hearing the news about [Dick](../character/dick.md) Moore's identity. They discuss how the resemblance between cousins [George](../character/george.md) and [Dick](../character/dick.md) led to the years-long mix-up, Leslie's newly found freedom, and the possibility of informing [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).

## CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [George](../character/george.md), [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) returns home alone and visits [Anne](../character/anne.md), explaining how [George](../character/george.md) Moore's memory returned and his sister took him home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). She recounts her emotional struggles and guilt leading up to the decision for the operation, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) comforts her during her grief and confusion.

## CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Shakespeare](../character/shakespeare.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) gives birth to a healthy ten-pound baby boy, bringing immense joy to the household after her earlier grief. Friends and family visit to admire the newborn, whom [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md) after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Miss Cornelia also reveals in secret that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to return for a visit.

## CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Gus](../character/gus.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — During a federal election, Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim discuss political opinions with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), celebrating or lamenting the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits the lighthouse, where she unknowingly snubs a freshly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) before having a poignant conversation with Captain Jim about his impending death, his lost love [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and his wish for [Anne](../character/anne.md) to care for [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md).

## CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about news from home before [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares updates about [George](../character/george.md) Moore's return and upcoming marriage. [Susan](../character/susan.md) arrives with news that her sister broke her leg, prompting [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to move into the house of dreams to keep [Anne](../character/anne.md) company during Susan's absence. [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visits and attempts to reconnect with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who is initially overwhelmed until [Anne](../character/anne.md) reassures her that she deserves happiness.

## CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to share the surprising news of her upcoming marriage to [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) playfully teases her about her long-standing opinions on men and political/religious differences, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers her congratulations and wedding advice.

## CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Owen and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confess their love for one another in the garden and seal their commitment. Afterward, they gather with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Captain Jim, who offers a warm and solemn benediction for their futures before taking his leave. [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns late from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), bringing news and expressing her surprise over Miss Cornelia's upcoming marriage.

## CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) present Captain Jim with the published copy of his life-book written by [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), which fills him with joy as he entertains them with tea. The next morning, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notices the lighthouse light is still burning after sunrise and goes with [Anne](../character/anne.md) to investigate. They enter the lighthouse and discover Captain Jim has peacefully passed away in his sleep with his life-book on his chest.

## Chapter 42

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Glen, [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), Merry Christmas, [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), Vancouver** — Following Captain Jim's passing and the success of his life book, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes buying the larger [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to accommodate their growing family and practice. Though reluctant to leave her beloved house of dreams, [Anne](../character/anne.md) ultimately agrees, especially after learning Owen intends to buy their old home for summer vacations. After packing up and saying an emotional farewell to each room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) lock up their house of dreams and depart for the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen).
